dish: Garlic butter steak with creamed spinach
causalSequence: bring steak to room temp; season salt pepper
sear in ripping-hot cast iron, ~2 min untouched per side
flip; add butter, smashed garlic, rosemary; tilt pan, spoon-baste ~2 min
pull at 57 C for medium-rare; rest 5-10 min
soften onion/shallot in butter; add garlic 1 min
add cream, nutmeg; simmer until reduced by half — no flour
wilt spinach into sauce in batches
slice steak; serve with creamed spinach
techniqueFacts: both creamed-spinach sources thicken by cream reduction plus cream cheese and parmesan — no flour or cornstarch (the gluten-free/keto lever)
heavy cream carries fewer carbs than milk or half-and-half (s3); per-serve net carbs observed at 5 g (s2) and ~2 g (s3)
spoon-basting the melted garlic-herb butter after the flip carries flavour into the crust (s1)
fresh spinach preferred over frozen — wilts straight into the sauce, no thaw-and-squeeze (s2, s3)
add spinach in batches; a large volume cooks right down (s2)
medium-rare is 57 C / 135 F internal; rest 5-10 min before slicing (s1, s0)
a splash of acid (lemon juice or white wine) cuts the richness of the cream (s0, s2)
spinach sheds water — if wilted separately, drain well before it meets the sauce (s0)
